This three-second synthetic fixture was generated locally with FFmpeg, using a
test pattern and 440/660 Hz sine waves. It contains two H.264 qualities and two
AAC languages in separate fMP4 tracks, with a static DASH SegmentTimeline.

Generation command (run inside this directory):

```powershell
rtk proxy ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i 'testsrc=size=160x90:rate=10' -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000' -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=660:sample_rate=48000' -t 3 -map 0:v -map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a -filter:v:1 'scale=80:44' -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -b:v:0 100k -b:v:1 50k -g 10 -keyint_min 10 -sc_threshold 0 -c:a aac -b:a 32k -metadata:s:a:0 language=eng -metadata:s:a:1 language=jpn -seg_duration 1 -use_template 1 -use_timeline 1 -adaptation_sets 'id=0,streams=v id=1,streams=2 id=2,streams=3' -f dash -n manifest.mpd
```

Tests serve these generated bytes from controlled HTTP origins. Playback/remux
tests use `NDM_TEST_FFMPEG_DIR`, pointing to the audited network-disabled build.
